tokens.name: color-accent-brand
tokens.usage: Brand accent: gradient start, icon tile fill, glow source. Not a CTA fill and never text on white.

tokens.name: color-accent-brand-hover
tokens.usage: `color-accent-brand` on hover.

tokens.name: color-accent-brand-active
tokens.usage: `color-accent-brand` while pressed.

tokens.name: color-accent-ai
tokens.usage: Gradient partner to `color-accent-brand` and the AI marker. Never a fill on its own.

tokens.name: color-accent-inverse-1
tokens.usage: The first accent for a dark area: stat numbers. Never on a light surface. Never on white. Engine step 200 of the sky palette. Contrast 8.24:1 on `color-background-inverse`.

tokens.name: color-accent-inverse-2
tokens.usage: The second accent for a dark area, beside `color-accent-inverse-1`: a second set of stat numbers. Never on a light surface. Never on white. Engine step 200 of the teal palette. Contrast 8.19:1 on `color-background-inverse`.

tokens.name: color-background-action
tokens.usage: The fill of the main button and of every filled action. It is the primary seed itself, not a fitted shade. The fill of every action: the primary CTA, with `color-foreground-on-action` as its label. Text in the action colour is `color-foreground-action`. Contrast 5.25:1 on `color-background-page`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-link-hover
tokens.usage: A link on hover, on a light surface. The colour changes; no underline appears. Contrast 7.03:1 on `color-background-page`.

tokens.name: color-background-action-hover
tokens.usage: The main button's fill on hover; nothing else about the button changes. A step `color-foreground-on-action` reads on: darker under a white label, primary step 400 under a black one.

tokens.name: color-foreground-action
tokens.usage: Text, an icon or a thin line in the action colour on a light surface: links, eyebrows, outline and ghost button labels, focus outlines. An engine step, which the engine solves to the same contrast for any seed. Contrast 5.24:1 on `color-background-page`, 4.82:1 on `color-background-tint`, 5.24:1 on `color-background-card`, 4.89:1 on `color-background-band`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-link
tokens.usage: A link in text, on a light surface. The same steps as `color-foreground-action`, named for the link so a link reads it. Contrast 5.24:1 on `color-background-page`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-on-action
tokens.usage: The label and icon on a `color-background-action` fill: black or white, whichever reads on it (the engine’s adaptive contrast). Contrast 5.25:1 on `color-background-action`, 7.03:1 on `color-background-action-hover`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-link-inverse
tokens.usage: Inline links on dark surfaces (`color-background-inverse`). Engine step 200 of the sky palette. Contrast 8.24:1 on `color-background-inverse`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-link-inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `color-foreground-link-inverse`: colour shift only. Engine step 100 of the sky palette. Contrast 11.17:1 on `color-background-inverse`.

tokens.name: footer-link-foreground
tokens.usage: Footer column links on the footer gradient. Engine step 600 of the dark palette's gray ramp. Contrast 11.07:1 on `color-background-inverse-raised`.

tokens.name: color-focus-ring
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring on a light surface: `focus-ring-width` at `focus-ring-offset`, `:focus-visible` only. Contrast 5.24:1 on `color-background-page`.

tokens.name: color-focus-ring-inverse
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring in an area that stays dark, such as the footer. `base.css` uses it inside an element with `data-on-dark`. Engine step 100 of the sky palette. Contrast 11.17:1 on `color-background-inverse`, 11.17:1 on `color-background-inverse`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-heading
tokens.usage: Headings, h1 to h6. Contrast 17.79:1 on `color-background-page`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-default
tokens.usage: Body text: the default colour of the page's text, and the labels of secondary buttons. Contrast 13.8:1 on `color-background-page`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-subtle
tokens.usage: Supporting text: the paragraph under a heading, the text of the utility bar, nav triggers at rest. Contrast 7.53:1 on `color-background-page`, 7.03:1 on `color-background-band`, 7.03:1 on `color-background-recessed`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-control
tokens.usage: Text in controls: the nav, buttons, list rows, chips. Contrast 10.43:1 on `color-background-page`, 9.74:1 on `color-background-band`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-faint
tokens.usage: Captions and small labels: card descriptions, counts. No body text is lighter than this. Contrast 4.94:1 on `color-background-page`, 4.62:1 on `color-background-band`, 4.94:1 on `color-background-card`, 4.55:1 on `color-background-tint`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a dark area. Engine step 900 of the dark palette's gray ramp. Contrast 17.25:1 on `color-background-inverse`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-inverse-faint
tokens.usage: Captions and small labels on a dark area. Engine step 400 of the dark palette's gray ramp. Contrast 7.17:1 on `color-background-inverse`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-decorative
tokens.usage: A decorative mark that carries no meaning, such as the caret in the nav row. It is lighter than 3:1 on purpose, so it never holds information. Contrast 2.59:1 on `color-background-page`.

tokens.name: color-foreground-error

tokens.name: color-foreground-info

tokens.name: color-foreground-warning-inverse

tokens.name: color-background-card

tokens.name: color-background-tint

tokens.name: footer-focus-ring
